teaser: One version of you is mid-story at the table, timing the laugh perfectly, pulling the whole room along. Another version is three drafts deep into a sentence nobody else will ever read, trying to get a feeling exactly right before it counts. You are a life path 3, built around expression, crossed with an INFP, built around meaning that has to be true before it is spoken. The particular thing this crossing does is ask the same hour of your day to be both performance and confession, and most weeks it only has room for one.
excerpt: Ten o'clock on a weeknight, the garage still smelling of amp heat from rehearsal.
